milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the potato crops (centered at spawn-relative [4, 1, 4]) and face them to demonstrate they have found them. Potatoes are placed at relative coords (3-5, 1, 3-4) on farmland.

Uses position_near_with_facing because interacting with a furnace requires the player to be near it and facing it. The furnace is at spawn-relative [-3, 0, 4]. We check the player is within 4 blocks and facing the furnace, which is the prerequisite for right-clicking it. Direct GUI interaction cannot be tracked via info dict, so proximity+facing is the best available check.

Uses inventory_has because charcoal is produced by smelting oak_log in a furnace and the resulting charcoal ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no charcoal, so having at least 1 confirms successful smelting.

Uses inventory_has because hay_block is crafted from 9 wheat on a crafting table and the resulting hay_block ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no hay_block, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting.
